nodes.name: Lemma 2.31: Variance Bound Exploiting Stability
nodes.statement: Let $P$ be a $\beta$-stable instance and $S$ be a set of centers with $N(S) \geq 2k$ then $\mathrm{Var}[X^{S,h}] \lesssim (2^{-2h} k)/(m N(S) \beta)$.

nodes.name: Lemma 2.28: Relating cost of Stable Inputs to Interaction
nodes.statement:
Let $P$ be a $\beta$-stable instance and $S\in \mathcal S(r)$ be a set of centers.
    For a center $x \in S$, 
    let $I(x)$ denote the set of clusters that interact with $x$; then $\textnormal{cost}(P,S) \geq \tfrac{1}{768} (|I(x)|-1) \beta \ensuremath{\mathsf{OPT}}_k$ .

nodes.name: Lemma 2.33: Worst Case Variance Bound
nodes.statement: Let $S$ be any set of centers. We have $\mathrm{Var}[X^{S,h}] \lesssim (2^{-2h-t}k)/(m \cdot k_{B(S)})$.

nodes.name: Lemma 2.32: Relating cost of Worst-Case Inputs to Interaction
nodes.statement: Let $S$ be a set of centers. Recall that $B(S)$ contains $k_{B(S)}$ clusters, all of which are from band $b$ and are of type $t$ for $S$. If $t\geq 6$ then $\textnormal{cost}(P,S) \gtrsim k_{B(S)} \cdot 2^{b+t}T$.
